data.one_liner: Quick and customizable giffy dialogs and bottom sheets with image, Rive, or Lottie animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use alert dialogs and bottom sheets styled with custom headers powered by images, Rive animations, or Lottie animations, along with flexible actions and titles.
use_when: You want to display visually engaging alert dialogs with animations or illustrations.
You need modal bottom sheets featuring Rive, Lottie, or image headers.
avoid_when: You only need standard platform-styled alert dialogs without decorative graphical headers.
You require complex state management solutions within your dialogs.
strengths: Supports multiple animation formats out of the box including Rive and Lottie.
Provides both dialog and bottom sheet variants with Material 2 and Material 3 support.
weaknesses: Relies on external animation packages which might increase app size if not used elsewhere.
Migration from version 1 to 2 involves breaking API changes.
